summary: Closed the residual lifespan-evidence/consensus consistency gaps in the cumulative Life Line PR. In src/content/blog/beginner/life-line.md, reworded 'Empirically, that reading has not held up' and 'That attempt has not held up' to say a reliable relationship between life-line length and lifespan has not been established (not disproved); reworded 'What has changed is the modern literature' to name Fincham, Gettings, and West instead of an anonymous 'modern literature'; replaced 'contemporary practitioners have moved away from it' in the closing section with the same named sources; and reworded the short-line section's 'Palmistry Path follows the modern reading, on the evidence set out above' so the modern short-line reading is attributed to editorial choice rather than to lifespan-vs-length evidence that never tested the transition interpretation. In src/content/lessons/lines/04-life-line.mdx, the parallel short-line sentence no longer says the older reading is set aside 'on the evidence,' and line 96's break-section sentence ('the readings above have no demonstrated reliability, and the modern literature has abandoned them') is reworded to state that not using a break to predict illness/injury/death is Palmistry Path's editorial position, since the published studies test line length against lifespan, not what a break marks. The verified three-study record and historical Cheiro/Benham attributions are unchanged; no new studies, claims, or palmistry interpretations were introduced. Added Pass 11 to docs/source-verification-log.md and extended docs/CURRENT_STATE.md's PP-RELAY-024 note.
verification: npm run build: 105 routes built cleanly, no errors
npm run content-audit: 60 blog posts, 25 lessons valid
npm run audit:all: links, images, schema, indexability, accessibility all pass

Keyword sweep of both touched files for held up/survived/reject/disprove/modern literature/modern practice/contemporary practitioner/evidence/studies/reliable/predict/lifespan/length of life/transition/break; every material occurrence in directly related passages inspected
Reconfirmed the three retained studies (Wilson & Mather 1974; Newrick, Affie & Corrall 1990; Lucas, Dhugga & Henneberg 2019) concern life-line length versus lifespan only, unchanged by this revision
Inspected cumulative diff origin/main...HEAD (not only the revision-6 hunk) for source integrity and internal consistency

source_preflight.notes: Remaining descriptive phrases such as 'Modern practitioners read it instead as marking...' and 'Contemporary practitioners read it as marking...' describe the interpretive convention itself (a palmistry meaning), not an evidentiary/consensus claim, and are outside this revision's authorized evidence-scope-consistency problem, so they were left unchanged consistent with the packet's scope limits.
